title: Five Places to Visit in Vancouver with a Local Lifestyle Editor
abstract: In a city with a sleek, squeaky-clean downtown, the lifestyle editor Sara Harowitz finds authenticity in a neighborhood that has retained its blue collar roots. She shares her favorite spots.

title: Five Places to Visit in Stockholm with a Local Craft Brewer
abstract: Henok Fentie, the Swedish craft brewer who runs one of the coolest bars in the city, shares his top spots in Sodermalm, the buzzy enclave where he grew up.
